## Research question

How are episode-level time, metadata, transcript, video, and audio features associated with reception of the original 1959–1964 series? Distinguish historical audience measurements, repeated modern ratings and vote counts, longitudinal changes, and series-level attention. Historical-to-modern comparisons require a separate measurement-comparability design; see the [project plan](../docs/TZ_PROJECT_PLAN.md).

## Limitations

This is an observational, exploratory analysis. Viewer selection, retrospective reputation, correlated features, and a small episode sample limit interpretation; associations do not establish causal effects.
